meta.name: card-xiaohongshu
meta.description: 小红书风格知识卡片, 多张联排可滑动浏览

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成小红书风格的知识卡片，支持多张联排滑动浏览
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常在小红书发布知识类图文内容
copy.tagline_en: Generate Xiaohongshu-style knowledge cards with multi-card swipeable layout
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often publish knowledge-based visual content on Xiaohongshu

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会生成多张小红书风格的图文卡片，每张尺寸 1080×1440，可纵向排列供截图。第一张是封面，中间每张讲一个核心观点，最后一张是总结加行动号召。
howto.when: 当你要求制作小红书风格的知识卡片或图文内容时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一套小红书卡片，讲5个高效学习技巧。
say.note: Claude 会生成封面、中间观点卡和总结卡。

say.text: 用莫兰迪配色，做3张关于时间管理的干货卡片。
say.note: Claude 会按指定配色和数量输出。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates multiple Xiaohongshu-style cards (1080×1440 each) arranged vertically for easy screenshotting. The first card is a cover, middle cards each present one key point, and the last card is a summary with a call to action.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to create Xiaohongshu-style knowledge cards or carousel posts.

say_en.text: Create a set of Xiaohongshu cards about 5 efficient study tips.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a cover, middle cards, and a summary card.

say_en.text: Make 3 cards about time management in Morandi colors.
say_en.note: Claude will output cards with the specified color scheme and count.
